rationale: Repository release readiness must never resolve package.json latest ranges.
The generated npm lockfile is compared byte-for-byte by SHA-256 before npm ci/build.
A changed transitive resolution fails readiness until the lock blueprint is intentionally reviewed and updated.

bootstrapEvidence.reviewNote: Top-level dependency versions remain exact and unchanged. Repeated CI jobs produced the same transitive lock hash; all control/safety/QA gates must re-pass on this reviewed graph before merge.
